headline: Travel Food Services Whole-time Director and CFO resigns
hook: Leadership change at Travel Food Services
summary: Travel Food Services Limited has officially notified the exchange about the resignation of its Key Managerial Personnel, who served as the Whole-time Director and Chief Financial Officer. The company did not disclose the immediate reasons for the departure or name a successor in the filing. Executive exits at the C-suite level can introduce short-term operational uncertainty for listed entities. Indian retail investors holding the stock should review upcoming corporate disclosures for clarity on leadership transition plans.
whats_next: Announcement of the successor CFO by the company
why_it_matters: CFO exit brings temporary leadership uncertainty.

headline: Travel Food Services intimates shareholders regarding final dividend remittance for FY25-26
hook: Final dividend payout communication sent to shareholders
summary: Travel Food Services Limited has sent communication letters to shareholders who lack registered email IDs but have registered their physical addresses. The letters pertain to the remittance of the final dividend for the financial year 2025-26. This is a routine regulatory compliance disclosure under SEBI listing regulations. Retail shareholders holding physical records should expect communication regarding their dividend status.
why_it_matters: Physical shareholders will receive FY26 dividend remittance details.
